scenes.headline: How an agent rebuilds a TV home screen
scenes.sub: What it runs over adb, and what stops a brick
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Spandrel! Today: what a coding agent actually runs when it cleans up your TV.

scenes.text: An Android TV takes the same debug commands as a phone, so an agent can switch vendor packages off and hand the Home button to a new launcher.
scenes.say: An Android TV is Android. An agent can use phone debug commands to switch vendor packages off and give the Home button to a new launcher.

steps.say: The agent connects over the home network with adb. You press Allow on the TV once, and it has a shell.
First it saves the package list and settings, so a restore script can put everything back.
Then it switches off ads, telemetry and promo packages for the main user. Nothing is uninstalled.
Last, it installs a small launcher and points the Home button at it.

scenes.title: What the guards refuse
scenes.say: The danger is what the command hits, so the scripts refuse four things.

items.say: Core Android packages, because one stick never booted again.
The current Home app, until something else can answer Home.
The setup wizard, if it owns the saved wireless network.
And input drivers, or the HDMI ports stay black.

steps.say: Before: the stock Google TV home, with a sponsored banner above the apps.
After: the replacement launcher. A clock, a greeting, and four big app tiles.

scenes.title: Lists disabling each package, of 248
scenes.say: Across two hundred and forty-eight lists, the Google layer is shared. Feedback is the most common target.

left.title: Root or custom ROM
items: Streaming can drop to lower resolution
left.say: Rooting means unlocking the bootloader. That wipes the device, can cut streaming quality, and often has no way back.

right.title: adb disable
items: State lives in the data partition
right.say: Disabling needs no root, and one restore, or a factory reset, undoes it.

scenes.text: Start with settings, then a launcher, then a reversible debloat. Root is the rung that is hardest to undo.
